evidence.note: isPolicyApproved is (readOnly && !destructive) || allowlist membership, so readOnly && !destructive implies approved across this producer.
evaluate co-computes destructive, readOnly, and approved from one tool and policy, then passes that triple into auditReason; the auto-approve combination is never written with approved=false.
